claims: As of April 20, 2026, average 30-year fixed mortgage refinance rates hover in the low-to-mid 6% range.
As of April 20, 2026, some 30-year fixed mortgage refinance options drop toward 6% or lower.
As of April 20, 2026, 15-year refinance rates average in the 5.3% to 5.7% range.
As of April 20, 2026, 15-year refinance rates are generally lower than 30-year fixed mortgage refinance rates.
As of April 20, 2026, 30-Year Fixed refinance rate averages ~5.99%–6.65%.
As of April 20, 2026, 15-Year Fixed refinance rate averages ~5.34%–5.75%.
As of April 20, 2026, 30-Year Jumbo refinance rate averages ~6.75%–6.78%.
Refinance rates are often slightly higher than purchase rates due to increased lender risk.
Refinancing typically costs 2%–6% of the loan amount.
Mortgage refinance rates vary by lender, credit score, and equity.
Some mortgage refinance rates like on Zillow show daily variations, as reported by Yahoo Finance.
Bank of America offers daily updated rates.
Rocket Mortgage offers daily updated rates.
